en.name: Claude Code
en.description: Claude Code in Textus AI: it reads your folder, writes and edits your notes, and asks before it changes anything.
en.setup: Needs Node.js, and Claude Code signed in once. In a terminal: npx -y @agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp@0.107.0 --cli auth login --claudeai
